title: Kestrel Transport Tariff — Transfer Shipping Fee Bands for Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Tariff rule.** For a signed order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements that is not an exchange replacement, the transfer shipping fee is the band fee of the shipping band that the full transfer distance falls in, reduced by the program's shipping fee discount and rounded half up to the cent. The shipping bands run from the first band, for distances up to the first band limit, through the second and third bands, for distances up to the second and third band limits, to the fourth band, for distances above the third band limit. No transfer shipping fee is owed when the transfer distance is no more than the program's free transfer distance.

| Band | Distance | Band limit | Band fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | up to 500 miles | 500 | $499.00 |
| 2 | 501 to 1000 miles | 1000 | $799.00 |
| 3 | 1001 to 1500 miles | 1500 | $1099.00 |
| 4 | more than 1500 miles | — | $1490.00 |

The transfer distance is the transport distance from the hub holding the vehicle to the buyer's market recorded on the order. The free transfer distance and the shipping fee discount are those of the order's vehicle program. The discount is taken as a percentage of the band fee, and the reduced figure is rounded half up to the cent.

**Worked examples (hypothetical orders).**

| Program (free distance, discount) | Transfer distance | Band | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line (0 miles, 0 percent) | 450 | 1 | $499.00 |
| Kestrel Certified (100 miles, 0 percent) | 100 | — | none owed |
| Kestrel Certified (100 miles, 0 percent) | 101 | 1 | $499.00 |
| Kestrel Certified Plus (100 miles, 25 percent) | 1200 | 3 | $1099.00 less 25 percent, $824.25 |
| Kestrel Premium Certified (250 miles, 50 percent) | 1600 | 4 | $1490.00 less 50 percent, $745.00 |
| Kestrel Premium Certified (250 miles, 50 percent) | 240 | — | none owed |

**Band edges.** A distance of exactly 1000 miles is in band 2; 1001 miles is in band 3. A distance of exactly 1500 miles is in band 3; 1501 miles is in band 4.
